title: Notes from Saturday’s recruiting call
body: Patience, a bigger school list, DMs, and a 1:1 with Mike. The written record is on Recruiting so nobody has to rewatch the Zoom.

title: Starz Gold hotel block is up
body: Stars National Walker rooms for Starz Gold (Oct 17–18) are at Holiday Inn Express and Suites Chester. Book the EventPipe team link on the weekend kit.

title: Scenic City hotel block is up
body: Stars National Walker rooms for Scenic City (Nov 6–8) are at Hampton Inn Cleveland. Booking link when Cynthia sends it.

title: Lone Star hotel is up
body: TownePlace Suites Fort Worth University Area/Medical Center for Lone Star (Nov 13–15). 3450 West Vickery. Booking link when Cynthia sends it.

title: Sunshine hotel block is up
body: Cynthia’s Stars National Walker rooms for Clermont (Nov 20–22) are on Fastbreak. Holiday Inn Express is the team block; other event hotels are on the same link. Book by Fri Sep 4.

title: East Coast hotel block is up
body: Stars Nationals — Walker rooms for Pennsville (Oct 23–25) are on the weekend kit. Stay-to-play — book the team link.

title: Fall schedule is locked in
body: Dates on the calendar are game days. Arrive the night before unless the event says you can drive in that morning. East Coast hotel block is posted; the rest of the weekends when the holds land.

title: Order the white pinstripes
body: Fall 2026 we added white pinstripe jerseys. If you don't have them yet, order them before the first tournament. GroupMe is still the team channel — this page is the written record so nobody has to scroll back for the call.
